name: drand-quicknet
description: Public drand randomness beacon (quicknet). One BLS signature every 3s; the round-R signature is the timelock decryption key for round R. Keyless, public.

operations.summary: Beacon parameters (genesis time, period seconds, chain hash). Use to compute the current round = floor((now - genesis)/period) + 1.
Latest published round and its signature.
Signature for a specific round. 404/absent until that round is reached — i.e. the key literally does not exist yet.
